baseline.bottleneck: Every queue mutation sends the complete growing queue to group peers, including worker sessions without a queue-view API.

change: Worker WebSocket sessions request claimQueueSnapshots=false on every upgrade. Full-Hub group delivery omits claim_queue only for explicit opt-out. Legacy and reactive queue transports retain snapshots; claim outcomes remain delivered.
assertions: Two Redis pubsub disconnects, each triggering all connected clients to reauthenticate and resume
Exact claim IDs and enqueue timestamps unchanged after each interruption
All 1000 claims granted with positive fences in original FIFO order
limits: Synthetic authentication and Redis INCR fence minting; SQL delta replay is mocked.
Not Rust/FUSE execution or live model agents. One Hub process only; no cross-host latency or production database.
Admission is sequential. Reconnect waves involve all 1000 clients. Test retries use 1–5ms delay.
Memory samples are end-of-run combined process RSS, not peak server memory.
Full queue snapshots are still reconstructed and published for interested peers. This does not establish 1000 reactive queue observers.
Two runs; no latency percentiles or prolonged outage/failover guarantee.
